column2: Proportion Of Teachers Who Have Received At Least The Minimum Organised Teacher Training By Level Of Education, Annual

column4: Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA)'s regulatory requirements for licensed centres stipulate that all pre-primary teachers must have the necessary qualifications (i.e. minimum organised pedagogical training) before being deployed to ECDA-licensed centres. Pre-primary teachers refer to staff within ECDA-licensed preschools (kindergartens and child care centres) and MOE Kindergartens (MKs) that provide developmentally-appropriate learning environments, as well as design and implement curriculum and activities for the care and/or education of children aged 3 to 6 years.
Data pertain to teachers from public and private educational institutions.

Singapore does not disaggregate the secondary school teacher data by lower secondary and upper secondary levels as teachers could teach both levels. Data pertain to teachers from public and private educational institutions.
